candidate_predicates.name: TESTS_HYPOTHESIS_WITH_PROBE
candidate_predicates.definition: A targeted probe action is performed to evaluate a specific hypothesis or uncertainty stated in reasoning, and the observation reports a result that is interpretable as evidence for or against that hypothesis.

parameters.name: probe_action
parameters.description: The action that inspects a property or performs a measurement chosen to test the hypothesis.

parameters.name: hypothesis_reasoning
parameters.description: The reasoning identifying the hypothesis, prediction, or uncertainty being tested.

parameters.name: probe_result
parameters.description: The observation reporting the outcome of the probe.

assertion_conditions: The hypothesis_reasoning states a specific testable hypothesis or uncertainty.
The probe_action inspects a property whose value is diagnostic of that hypothesis.
The probe_result supplies an outcome that can be interpreted for or against the hypothesis.
exclusion_conditions: The action is exploratory but not directed at any stated hypothesis.
The observation is unrelated to or uninterpretable for the hypothesis.
No identifiable hypothesis or uncertainty motivates the probe.

candidate_predicates.name: REVISES_INTERPRETATION_AFTER_CONTRADICTORY_OBSERVATION
candidate_predicates.definition: Reasoning explicitly changes or replaces a prior interpretation because an observation reports evidence inconsistent with that interpretation.

parameters.name: revised_reasoning
parameters.description: The reasoning that acknowledges the contradiction and adopts a revised interpretation or alternative hypothesis.

parameters.name: contradictory_observation
parameters.description: The observation whose content conflicts with the prior interpretation.

assertion_conditions: The observation contains a result inconsistent with the interpretation under consideration.
The revised_reasoning explicitly notes the inconsistency and abandons, narrows, or replaces the prior interpretation.
exclusion_conditions: The reasoning merely repeats or records the observation without revising an interpretation.
The observation is consistent with the prior interpretation.
No alternative or revised interpretation is articulated.

candidate_predicates.name: ASSESSES_CANDIDATE_AGAINST_CONSTRAINTS
candidate_predicates.definition: Reasoning extracts or considers a candidate value from an observation and evaluates whether it satisfies one or more explicitly stated requirements, reporting compliance, partial compliance, or violation.

parameters.name: assessment_reasoning
parameters.description: The reasoning that evaluates the candidate against the stated requirements.

parameters.name: candidate_evidence
parameters.description: The observation containing the candidate value or the evidence from which it is extracted.

assertion_conditions: The observation contains an identifiable candidate value or fragment.
The assessment_reasoning refers to at least one explicit requirement and compares the candidate to it.
The reasoning reaches a conclusion about compliance, partial compliance, or noncompliance.
exclusion_conditions: The reasoning only extracts or repeats the candidate without evaluating requirements.
No explicit requirement is applied to the candidate.
The observation does not contain the candidate being assessed.

candidate_predicates.name: ASSEMBLES_COMPOSITE_CANDIDATE_FROM_COMPLEMENTARY_OBSERVATIONS
candidate_predicates.definition: Reasoning combines distinct, non-overlapping pieces of evidence from two or more observations into a single composite candidate that is proposed for verification or accepted as a solution.

parameters.name: assembly_reasoning
parameters.description: The reasoning that recognizes the fragments as complementary and forms the composite candidate.

parameters.name: fragment_observations
parameters.description: The observations that collectively supply the distinct fragments combined into the candidate; support is collective, not alternative.

assertion_conditions: At least two observations each supply a distinct part of the candidate rather than duplicating the same part.
The assembly_reasoning explicitly links the parts as complementary and combines them into one candidate.
The combined candidate is used to satisfy a stated structural requirement or to motivate a subsequent verification step.
exclusion_conditions: The candidate is obtained from a single observation only.
The observations supply overlapping or redundant copies of the same fragment without a combination relation.
The reasoning lists fragments but does not combine them into a candidate.

candidate_predicates.name: VERIFIES_CANDIDATE_BY_TARGETED_REEXTRACTION
candidate_predicates.definition: A candidate or candidate fragment is checked by re-reading the exact stored location or field from which it was claimed to originate, and the returned bytes are compared with the candidate.

parameters.name: verification_reasoning
parameters.description: The reasoning selecting the candidate and the exact location or field to re-read.

parameters.name: extraction_action
parameters.description: The action that retrieves bytes or data from the identified location.

parameters.name: extraction_result
parameters.description: The observation reporting the retrieved data for comparison with the candidate.

assertion_conditions: The verification_reasoning identifies a candidate or fragment and a specific location, offset, or field to inspect.
The extraction_action retrieves data from that identified location rather than performing an untargeted search.
The extraction_result contains data that can be directly compared with the candidate, confirming or refuting it.
exclusion_conditions: The action is an untargeted exploration not tied to a proposed candidate.
The retrieved data cannot be compared with the candidate.
The reasoning does not identify what is being verified or where it should be found.

candidate_predicates.name: EXCLUDES_ALTERNATIVE_CANDIDATES_BY_EXHAUSTIVE_SEARCH
candidate_predicates.definition: Reasoning establishes that a candidate is unique or that no competing candidate satisfies the relevant criterion by directing an exhaustive search over the available artifact and interpreting the search result as excluding alternatives.

parameters.name: exclusion_reasoning
parameters.description: The reasoning that seeks to rule out competing candidates or confirm uniqueness.

parameters.name: exhaustive_search_action
parameters.description: The action that enumerates occurrences of a relevant pattern across the available artifact.

parameters.name: search_result
parameters.description: The observation listing the occurrences found by the search.

assertion_conditions: The exclusion_reasoning identifies a need to rule out alternatives or confirm that a candidate is the only qualifying occurrence.
The exhaustive_search_action searches the relevant artifact for a pattern or feature rather than checking a single known location.
The search_result shows that no additional qualifying candidate was found, or that the only qualifying hit is the known candidate, and the reasoning uses this to exclude alternatives.
exclusion_conditions: The search is limited to a single known location and cannot reveal alternatives.
The observation reports additional qualifying candidates that are not excluded.
The search result is not interpreted as relevant to uniqueness or alternative exclusion.

candidate_predicates.name: DISAMBIGUATES_INCIDENTAL_MATCH_BY_CONTEXT
candidate_predicates.definition: Reasoning treats a pattern match as an incidental false positive after inspecting its surrounding context and finding that the context violates a requirement that a true candidate would satisfy.

parameters.name: disambiguation_reasoning
parameters.description: The reasoning that considers the match ambiguous and decides whether its context supports or undermines it.

parameters.name: context_inspection_action
parameters.description: The action that retrieves bytes or data surrounding the ambiguous match.

parameters.name: context_observation
parameters.description: The observation showing the surrounding context of the match.

assertion_conditions: A prior search or extraction has produced a match that is not yet distinguished from a valid candidate.
The disambiguation_reasoning identifies the need to inspect the match's surrounding context.
The context_observation shows adjacent or nearby content that is incompatible with a valid candidate, and the reasoning uses this to classify the match as incidental.
exclusion_conditions: The match is already uniquely established without contextual inspection.
The context is not inspected or is not used to classify the match.
The surrounding content is compatible with a valid candidate, so the match is not dismissed as incidental.

candidate_predicates.name: CONFIRMS_SOLUTION_AGAINST_ALL_CONSTRAINTS
candidate_predicates.definition: Reasoning explicitly checks a proposed solution against every stated requirement and concludes that all requirements are satisfied.

parameters.name: confirmation_reasoning
parameters.description: The reasoning that enumerates and checks the solution against the stated requirements.

assertion_conditions: The confirmation_reasoning explicitly addresses all stated requirements relevant to the solution.
For each checked requirement, the reasoning states that the proposed solution satisfies it.
The reasoning concludes that the proposed solution is valid or ready to be committed.
exclusion_conditions: Only a subset of the stated requirements is checked.
The reasoning checks requirements but does not conclude that they are all satisfied.
The reasoning merely asserts validity without linking it to the stated requirements.

candidate_predicates.name: COMMITS_VERIFIED_SOLUTION
candidate_predicates.definition: A solution that reasoning has already confirmed as satisfying the relevant requirements is written or otherwise committed to the required output artifact, and the observation reports that the commit succeeded.

parameters.name: commit_action
parameters.description: The action that writes or persists the confirmed solution to the required output.

parameters.name: confirmation_reasoning
parameters.description: The reasoning establishing that the solution satisfies the relevant requirements before the commit.

parameters.name: commit_result
parameters.description: The observation reporting whether the commit operation succeeded.

assertion_conditions: The confirmation_reasoning establishes that the solution satisfies the relevant requirements before the commit action.
The commit_action targets the required output artifact and contains the confirmed solution.
The commit_result reports successful completion of the commit operation.
exclusion_conditions: The action is performed before the solution has been confirmed.
The action writes unrelated or unconfirmed content.
The observation reports failure or does not report the commit outcome.

candidate_predicates.name: CORROBORATES_CANDIDATE_WITH_INDEPENDENT_METADATA
candidate_predicates.definition: Reasoning uses a separately recorded metadata value, such as a length, size, count, or structural field, to check the consistency of a proposed candidate and thereby corroborate or undermine it.

parameters.name: corroboration_reasoning
parameters.description: The reasoning that compares the candidate with the independent metadata value.

parameters.name: metadata_observation
parameters.description: The observation containing the metadata value used for the consistency check.

assertion_conditions: The metadata_observation contains a value that is independent of the candidate's own expression, such as a stored length, size, or count.
The corroboration_reasoning compares the candidate or its expected properties with that metadata value.
The comparison yields a consistency result that the reasoning uses to corroborate or undermine the candidate.
exclusion_conditions: The metadata is merely the candidate itself or a direct repetition of it.
The reasoning mentions metadata without comparing it to the candidate.
No consistency conclusion is drawn from the metadata.
